paragraphs.text: 据摘要，根据 Takematsu 与 Yamaoka（1997）研究，中岛树白蚁（Glyptotermes nakajimai）与树白蚁属（Glyptotermes）的旧异名 Glyptotermes kushimensis 的工蚁表皮碳氢化合物组成相同，形态特征亦相符；作者据此把树白蚁属（Glyptotermes）的旧异名 Glyptotermes kushimensis 与 Glyptotermes kodamai 一并降为中岛树白蚁的次异名。
paragraphs.text_en: According to the study by Takematsu and Yamaoka (1997), Glyptotermes nakajimai shares its worker cuticular hydrocarbon composition with the old synonym Glyptotermes kushimensis, and their morphological characters also agree; on this basis the authors synonymized the old synonyms Glyptotermes kushimensis and Glyptotermes kodamai under Glyptotermes nakajimai.
paragraphs.text_es: Según el estudio de Takematsu y Yamaoka (1997), Glyptotermes nakajimai comparte la composición de hidrocarburos cuticulares de sus obreras con el sinónimo antiguo Glyptotermes kushimensis, y sus caracteres morfológicos también coinciden; sobre esta base, los autores sinonimizaron los sinónimos antiguos Glyptotermes kushimensis y Glyptotermes kodamai bajo Glyptotermes nakajimai.

references.citation: Takematsu, Y.; Yamaoka, R. 1997. Taxonomy of Glyptotermes (Isoptera, Kalotermitidae) in Japan with reference to cuticular hydrocarbon analysis as chemotaxonomic characters. Esakia.
